card.name: Spacing words before minutes or hours
card.fires_on: The space or small linking word (such as "within" or "to") right before a number of minutes or hours in dosing and timing instructions. It predicts that a time unit comes soon.

modes.label: Space before a time number
modes.description: The gap right after a verb or phrase like inhalations, wait, or at least, just before a minute count.
modes.example: Wait<< >>10 minutes and measure the FEV

modes.label: Linking word in a time range
modes.description: The word "within" or "to" just before or inside a time span that ends in hours or minutes.
modes.example: In the event of vomiting<< within>> 1 hour after dosing, a

card.writes: It pushes the model to write hour or minutes as the next time unit.
card.plain: It spots the spot in a dosing instruction where a length of time in minutes or hours is about to be given.
